description: Model outputs recorded from a real V1 live run (openai/gpt-oss-20b via BullsAI) of RIPPLE analyzing its own repository. Only the model's interpretation and action decisions are kept; replaying them through the V1 controller on the same commit reproduces the run. Development data, not a benchmark task.
